claim: Repeatedly documented bodily signs and bleeding
limitation: Distinguish observed surface findings from their cause.

claim: Persistent bleeding during eight medication-free days of bandaging
status: Early signed report reproduced; also acknowledged by critical historian
limitation: Directly relevant to continuous chemical-reapplication hypothesis.

claim: Daily intact seal checks
limitation: Not one continuously unopened dressing; distinguish later procedural recollections from short signed report.

claim: All examinations establish penetrating holes
limitation: Reports differ in depth and time; Romanelli stronger, Bignami/Festa describe intact bones and differing tissue findings.

claim: Perfect front/back correspondence
limitation: Editor and Festa identify nonexact correspondence.

claim: Normal skin and no visible scars shortly after death
limitation: Sala 7 July 1969; preceding depth not directly inspected by him.

claim: Every wound suddenly disappeared precisely at death
limitation: Sources also describe gradual earlier fading.

claim: 100mL/day whole-blood equivalent for decades
limitation: Iron-budget inference depends on uncertain inputs.

claim: Normal blood findings in 1954
limitation: Not a 50-year longitudinal anemia study.

claim: Fragrance associated with Pio and materials
limitation: No chemical source identification or blinded protocol recovered.

claim: 48–50-degree readings reported in an early newspaper
limitation: Original Le Soir page remains to be obtained.

claim: Bath thermometers shattered: quoted Merla/Giuva clause
limitation: Italian quoted clause says readings stopped at those levels; neighboring sentence separately mentions bursting thermometers.

claim: Festa personally watched repeated extreme temperature readings
limitation: His own supervised readings normal; superior took later exceptional readings with instrument left behind.

claim: Sustained core temperature 48–52 degrees
limitation: Axillary reports deserve investigation; no specific deception established.

claim: Colella recovery investigated and deemed inexplicable by five-member medical board
status: Substantial participant account and official process confirmation
limitation: Original chart and signed full expert reports not obtained.

claim: Colella instantly recovered without treatment
limitation: Intensive treatment and recovery over days/weeks are documented.

claim: Mortality mathematically 100% for anyone with six failed organs
status: Not established as a universal claim
limitation: Need comparable definitions, severity, population and original prognostic source.

claim: Savino had an entirely absent eye regenerated
limitation: Muse flags ambiguous term; hospital original and early circular missing. Widow distinguishes surviving injured eye from replacement eye.

claim: Chemical access proves manufactured stigmata
limitation: Documented request supplies an investigative lead, not a causal demonstration.

claim: Pio described bilocation under oath in 1921
limitation: Castelli English p208; primary page not independently obtained. Description leaves bodily vs representational nature open.

claim: Knowledge of hidden sins
limitation: Italian Castelli p225; strongest named recipient cases still require original-document audit.

claim: Festa reports fragrance from transported cloth and reactions in Rome
limitation: Festa himself anosmic; distinguishes others’ reactions from his own observation.

claim: Friday intensification of bleeding
status: Early self-report and multiple witness accounts
limitation: No blinded quantitative weekday series; some accounts retrospective.

claim: Bleeding during Mass
status: Directly reported by named attendants and bandaging-test witnesses
limitation: Gloves removed at Mass; consistent physiological peak not quantified.

claim: Greco says Pio named an unconfessed incident with year and location
status: Filmed first-person testimony and matching written account
limitation: Same witness, not independent records of confession itself; original interview date unknown.

claim: De Martino fluid resolved without medical or surgical treatment
limitation: Discharge diagnosis suspected thoracic-duct leak; primary films/fluid chemistry not obtained.

claim: Similar cervical/mediastinal lymphatic swellings can resolve in days
limitation: Relevant overlaps, not retrospective diagnosis; HonorHealth patient received thoracentesis and MCT diet.

claim: Agnese Stump bone restoration after tumor
limitation: Ruffin 1991 pp382–383 and Schug 1987 pp85–89; original pathology/radiographs not recovered; prior surgery must be included.

claim: Wojtyła reported recovery before planned surgery in November 1962
limitation: Documents reported recovery and prayer, not pathology confirmation.

claim: Półtawska says doctors allowed an inflammatory alternative
limitation: Pamphlet reprint provenance incomplete; editorial canonization claim should not override Vatican record.

claim: Fragrance reports recur across Pio’s ministry and continue after death, including on objects
status: Broad reported phenomenon; examples mapped, not a completed independent-witness census
limitation: Different objects and episodes; no claim of decades of continuous instrumental measurement.

claim: Knowledge of unconfessed sins is a recurrent claim by many penitents, not limited to Greco
limitation: Complete original testimony corpus not yet audited; no numerical count of independently verified disclosures assigned.
